title: Configure npm publish settings in package.json
description: Configure the files field and publishConfig in package.json for npm publishing. Add a prepublishOnly script that runs the build before publishing.
acceptanceCriteria: 'files' field in package.json includes dist/, bin/, src/templates/, README.md
npm pack --dry-run shows only the expected files

steps.details: Add: "publishConfig": { "access": "public" }. Add to scripts: "prepublishOnly": "npm run build"
Run `npm pack --dry-run` and review the file list. Confirm it includes template files and dist/ but NOT test files, .agent/, or source .ts files (except templates).

technicalNotes: access: 'public' is required for scoped packages (@org/package-name) but good practice for all npm packages
The 'files' field is a whitelist — only listed files are included in the published package
